name: openbb_institutional_ownership
description:
Institutional ownership summary for one stock from SEC 13F data through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.ownership.institutional).
Returns: {symbol, holders: [records per filing date with investor counts, shares held, ownership percent and changes]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (fmp only in OpenBB 4.6, which needs a key; default fmp).
Top named holders without a key: yf_institutional_holders, yf_mutual_fund_holders. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
